declaredEnvVars.name: LND_REST_HOST
declaredEnvVars.description: LND REST API URL (recommended wallet; pair with LND_MACAROON). A wallet is optional — without one, free tools and marketplace search still work; paid calls return their payment challenge.

declaredEnvVars.name: LND_MACAROON
declaredEnvVars.description: Hex-encoded macaroon for LND (use a pay-scoped macaroon in production). Required with LND_REST_HOST.

declaredEnvVars.name: NWC_URI
declaredEnvVars.description: Nostr Wallet Connect string — easiest setup, works with CoinOS, Alby Hub, Zeus, and more. Alternative to LND.

declaredEnvVars.name: LNBITS_URL
declaredEnvVars.description: LNbits instance URL (pair with LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY). Alternative wallet.

declaredEnvVars.name: LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY
declaredEnvVars.description: Admin API key for LNbits. Required with LNBITS_URL.

declaredEnvVars.name: PHOENIXD_URL
declaredEnvVars.description: Phoenixd HTTP API URL (pair with PHOENIXD_PASSWORD). Alternative wallet.

declaredEnvVars.name: PHOENIXD_PASSWORD
declaredEnvVars.description: HTTP password for Phoenixd. Required with PHOENIXD_URL.

declaredEnvVars.name: BUDGET_SATS
declaredEnvVars.description: Maximum sats the server may spend per session (process lifetime), across ALL sources. Unset = unlimited; 0 = free tools only. The config file's budget.sat takes precedence.

declaredEnvVars.name: BOLTHUB_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
declaredEnvVars.description: Account token for tools that act on YOUR bolthub account (workspace, listing, audit, earnings, and node tools). Optional even for those: the connect_account tool pairs via the browser instead. Never needed to discover, call, or pay for APIs — buying is account-less.

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer token using your agent API key (format: Bearer <key>). Not needed when using OAuth — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, and ChatGPT authenticate via OAuth automatically.

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer sk_live_... API key from your Adside account

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer <your bai_ API key from https://boundaryai.ai — free, self-serve>

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer aura_read_YOUR_KEY. Create a read-only project key in the Auralogs dashboard under Settings, API & MCP keys.

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Optional. Recommended: OAuth 2.0. Omit this header and your MCP client will discover /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and run browser-based authorization (tokens auto-refresh for 30 days, no keys to copy). Alternative: API key. Send 'Bearer agentdm_<token>' from https://app.agentdm.ai for server-to-server use.

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Optional. 'Bearer <b4_... key>' unlocks the Pro workflow tools (b4_audit, b4_compare, b4_recommend). The free tier (b4_browse, b4_score) needs no credentials.

declaredHeaders.name: x-api-key
declaredHeaders.description: Inferventis API key — obtain at inferventis.ai

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer <project API key> (oah_...). Request beta access at enterprise@aisecuritygateway.ai

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer token: OAuth access token (Claude/ChatGPT) or AlphaCreek MCP API key from dashboard

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Bearer token using your AdWeave API key (aw_ prefix)

declaredHeaders.name: Authorization
declaredHeaders.description: Send 'Bearer <your Bareun API key>'. Alternatively send the key in an 'api-key' header. Get a key at https://bareun.ai.

declaredHeaders.name: x-api-key
declaredHeaders.description: Baselight API key. Generate one at https://baselight.app under account settings.

declaredEnvVars.name: ARMOR_API_KEY
declaredEnvVars.description: AnomalyArmor API key (aa_live_*). Generate at https://app.anomalyarmor.ai/settings/api-keys.

declaredEnvVars.name: AUTONOMAD_API_URL
declaredEnvVars.description: Autonomad API base URL. Defaults to production.

declaredEnvVars.name: AUTONOMAD_AGENT_MODE
declaredEnvVars.description: Set to 'true' to expose autonomous-agent tools (register_agent, DID-based booking). Default human mode is for Claude/ChatGPT users.

declaredEnvVars.name: BOREALHOST_API_KEY
declaredEnvVars.description: BorealHost API key (format: bh_<48 hex chars>). Optional — you can also call register() or set_api_key() at runtime.
